description: Source code for SobolEngine operations in PyTorch, including functions for drawing samples, fast-forwarding, scrambling, and initializing the Sobol quasi-random sequence generator.

methods.name: _sobol_engine_draw
methods.description: Draws samples from a SobolEngine given its state, returning a tuple of result tensor and updated quasi-random sequence.

methods.name: _sobol_engine_ff_
methods.description: Fast-forwards the SobolEngine state based on its current state and number of samples to generate.

methods.name: _sobol_engine_scramble_
methods.description: Randomizes the SobolEngine state variables using lower triangular matrices for scrambling.

methods.name: _sobol_engine_initialize_state_
methods.description: Initializes the main state variable of a SobolEngine based on its dimension.
